subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Should the Teams Graph media fallback for channel/group text/html stubs be always attempted, or should it land behind an explicit default-off graphMediaFallback setting?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the two open fix candidates expose a product tradeoff between recovering inbound attachments automatically and avoiding extra Graph lookups or mention-only diagnostics for existing deployments.

options.title: Config-gated fallback plus channel URL fixes
options.body: Combine the channel URL/root-cause repairs with a default-off Graph media fallback setting so operators opt into the extra Graph lookup cost.

options.title: Always-on narrowed fallback
options.body: Accept the channel-focused fix that attempts Graph lookup for non-personal Teams text/html stubs without adding a config key.

options.title: Pause for more tenant proof
options.body: Keep both candidates open until maintainers have live proof across channel, group-chat, and mention-only variants.

recommendation.title: Config-gated fallback plus channel URL fixes
recommendation.body: Combine the channel URL/root-cause repairs with a default-off Graph media fallback setting so operators opt into the extra Graph lookup cost.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the broadest history across the Teams plugin boundary and is the best available routing owner for the fallback/config policy decision.
